summary: Learn to shape humanitarian evidence, results and budgets into review-ready proposals. Explore the five-day course and its practical exercises.
lede: Humanitarian proposal development helps programme officers, proposal writers and grants managers turn needs evidence into feasible, costed funding submissions. The course covers reviewing donor calls and evidence quality, shaping response logic and indicators, assessing partner delivery feasibility, and costing activities in Excel while aligning the narrative, results framework and budget.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape humanitarian funding submissions or provide the evidence, delivery plans and cost inputs that make them credible.
prerequisites: No prior proposal-drafting experience is required. Basic familiarity with humanitarian response terminology is useful. Bring a laptop with existing Word and Excel access; no coding is required.
